DM Sans and Manrope, downloaded 2026-11-24 from Google Fonts CSS2 for weights 400–800.
Original font URLs are recorded in sources.json. fonts.css uses local files only.
Licenses: dmsans-OFL.txt and manrope-OFL.txt, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Source families: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmsans
                https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope
No runtime connection to Google Fonts is needed.
